title: Strength
wikitext:
{{about|the strength attribute|the passive skill|Strength (passive skill)}} The '''strength''' [[attribute]] is a measure of a character's physical power. Strength is required to use strength-based [[equipment]] and [[skill]]s. Strength also provides certain inherent bonuses: * Every 2 strength grants an additional 1 maximum [[life]]. * Every 5 strength grants 1% increased melee [[physical damage]]. ==Additional Strength Scaling== ===Additional stat per x strength=== Certain [[unique item|unique items]] can impart additional scaling to strength: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.class_id != "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%per\_%\_str%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ===Threshold uniques=== Some unique items have additional effects when meeting certain Strength requirements: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.class_id != "Jewel" AND (item_stats.id LIKE "%with_%_or_more_str%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%over%str%") |large=1 |stat=1 }} ===Threshold jewels=== Strength [[Threshold Jewels|Threshold]] [[List_of_unique_jewels|Unique Jewels]] provide additional benefits to specific [[skills]] when there is 40 '''Strength''' within the jewel's medium radius on the [[Passive skill|passive tree]]. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND item_stats.id LIKE "%with_%_str_in_radius%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ===Other jewels=== One [[List_of_unique_jewels|unique jewel]] provides additional scaling based off of nearby allocated '''Strength''' on the passive tree: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.class_id = "Jewel" AND (item_stats.id LIKE "%per_%_str%" OR item_stats.id LIKE "%str%apply%") AND item_stats.id NOT LIKE "%with_%_str_in_radius%" |large=1 |stat=1 }} ===Misc=== Some [[skill gems]], [[keystones]], or items provide other scaling for the innate increased Melee Physical Damage bonus from strength. *[[Iron Will Support]] *[[Iron Grip]] ==Base Strength== The [[Marauder]] starts with 32 base '''Strength''', the highest of any [[class]]. The [[Duelist]] and [[Templar]] start with 23 Strength, the [[Scion]] with 20, and the [[Ranger]], [[Witch]], and [[Shadow]] with 14. ==Modifying Strength== Strength can be increased by stacking base Strength and/or All Attributes and X% increased Strength and/or Attributes modifiers. ===Implicit Strength on Items=== Many [[Modifiers#Implicit_modifiers|implicit modifiers]] provide base strength on items: {{Drop enabled base item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=item_stats.id LIKE "additional_%strength%" OR item_stats.id = "additional_all_attributes" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Strength |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_strength |stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_dexterity |stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_strength_and_intelligence |stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes }} ===Strength on Equipment=== Weapons and armour must have strength as an attribute requirement in order for strength to appear as an affix. Strength affixes can appear on the following base item categories: * [[Amulets]], [[Rings]], and [[Belts]] * [[Armour (equipment)]] with strength as an attribute requirement, i.e. anything that provides [[armour]] as an implicit [[defence]]. * [[Weapons]] with strength as an attribute requirement, including [[Axes]], [[Swords]], [[Maces]], [[Sceptres]], and [[Staff|Staves]]. The strength affixes range from {{c|mod|+8 to 55}} and are bracketed by [[item level]]. Strength as an affix is always a suffix. The highest strength suffix is {{c|mod|of the Gods}}. The item level required for this affix is 82. Crafting benches have recipes which allow adding strength to non-strength-based armour with a value from {{c|mod|+15 to 30}}. The recipes are unlocked with game progress. More powerful hybrid variants can be unlocked by [[Veiled mod|unveiling]]. [[Jewels]] have their own suffixes which grant strength. Keep in mind that jewels can only have 4 affixes: 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes. * {{c|mod|of Strength}} {{c|mod|+12 to 16}} * {{c|mod|of Spirit}} {{c|mod|+8 to 10}} (Strength and Intelligence) * {{c|mod|of Athletics}} {{c|mod|+8 to 10}} (Strength and Dexterity) * {{c|mod|of Adaption}} {{c|mod|+6 to 8}} (all Attributes) In addition, [[Essence|Essences]] [[Deafening Essence of Rage|of Rage]] guarantee strength of {{c|mod|+13 to 58}} on any non-weapon equipment, potentially higher than without essences. This also has the added possibility of strength on non-strength armour. ===Attributes on Equipment=== {{c|mod|All Attributes}} affixes can appear on the following base item categories. These modifiers are always suffixes. * [[Amulets]] from {{c|mod|+1 to 32}} * [[Rings]] from {{c|mod|+1 to 16}} * [[Jewels]] from {{c|mod|+6 to 8}} ({{c|mod|of Adaption}}) The game has an {{c|mod|All Attributes}} crafting suffix mod that can be discovered in the lab [[Trial of Ascendancy|trial]] in [[The Tunnel]]. The mod {{c|mod|+(10 to 13) to all Attributes}} can be crafted onto the all items except [[flask]], [[belt]], [[jewel]], and [[map]]. ===Unique Items with Additional Strength=== Certain [[unique items]] provide bonuses to base strength or all attributes. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=item_stats.id LIKE "additional_%strength%" OR item_stats.id = "additional_all_attributes" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Strength |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=additional_strength |stat_column1_stat2_id=additional_strength_and_dexterity |stat_column1_stat3_id=additional_strength_and_intelligence |stat_column1_stat4_id=additional_all_attributes }} ===Increasing or Reducing Strength=== A number of [[unique item|unique items]] provide percent (%) increases to strength. All strength from equipment and passives will be scaled by these modifiers. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=item_stats.id = "strength_+%" OR item_stats.id = "all_attributes_+%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Strength |stat_column1_format=%s%% |stat_column1_stat_format=add |stat_column1_stat1_id=strength_+% |stat_column1_stat2_id=all_attributes_+% }} ===Other Ways to Modify Strength=== Converting one attribute to another is called ''transforming''. This can be done on the [[passive skill tree]] by socketing certain unique [[jewels]]. In a large radius, they will transform one attribute - granted by allocated skills in the area - to another attribute. {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |+ Attribute-transforming jewels |- ! From/To ! Strength ! Dexterity ! Intelligence |- ! Strength | {{n/a}} || {{il|Fluid Motion}} || {{il|Brute Force Solution}} |- ! Dexterity | {{il|Inertia}} || {{n/a}} || {{il|Fertile Mind}} |- ! Intelligence | {{il|Efficient Training}} || {{il|Careful Planning}} || {{n/a}} |} ==Modifiers== ===Corrupted=== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND generation_type = 5 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ===Crafted=== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND domain = 9 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ===Unveiled=== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND domain = 28 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ===Essences=== {{Query base item |where = items.class_id = "StackableCurrency" AND items.tags HOLDS "essence" AND items.description like "%strength%" |orderby = essences.type ASC, essences.level ASC |large=1 |description=1 |essence=1 }} {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND mods.id LIKE "%Essence%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ===Synthesis=== {{#cargo_query: |tables=synthesis_mods, synthesis_mods__mod_ids, mods |join on=synthesis_mods._ID = synthesis_mods__mod_ids._rowID, synthesis_mods__mod_ids._value=mods.id |fields=required_level=Req.
lvl,CONCAT("[[", mods._pageName, "|", mods.stat_text_raw, "]]")=Mods, item_class_ids=Classes |where= id LIKE "%Strength%" }} ===Crucible Passive Skill Tree=== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%line_strength%" AND generation_type = 31 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ====Crucible Passive Skill Tree Mutation==== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND generation_type = 32 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ===Others=== {{modifier table |q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= mod_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%line_strength%" AND generation_type NOT IN (3,5,31,32) AND domain NOT IN (9,28) AND mods.id NOT LIKE "%Essence%" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} ==Passives== There are [[passive skill]] nodes that grant additional strength or a combination of bonuses including strength. {{Query base passive skills |where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%brequel%" }} ===Masteries=== The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Strength: {{Query masteries}} ===Cluster Jewel Passives=== The following cluster jewel passives are related to Strength {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND (passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%increased strength%" OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%to strength%") AND NOT passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "+10 to strength" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Ascendancy Passives=== There are a few [[Ascendancy]] passive skills that grant strength or additional strength scaling. {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%strength%" }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|0.9.3| * Strength now provides a physical damage increase and additional Life. }} {{Version history table end}} {{sister|poe2wiki}} [[Category:Attributes]]
